description_en: Modifies an IPv6 Translation Service mapping entry
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-ipv6-translator-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-translator-entry-id ipv6trans-bp1858ys0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyIPv6TranslatorEntry

parameters.help_en: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的地域。 您可以通过调用 DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv6 Translation Service mapping entry
parameters.name: ipv6_translator_entry_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the IPv6 Translation Service mapping entry. The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换映射条目的名称。长度为2~100个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，英文句号（.），下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以http:// 或https://开头。
parameters.name: entry_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the IPv6 Translation Service mapping entry. The description must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换映射条目的描述信息。长度为2~100个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，英文句号（.），下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以http:// 或https://开头。
parameters.name: entry_description

parameters.help_en: The port used by the IPv6 address allocated by the IPv6 Translation Service instance
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例分配的IPv6地址的使用端口。
parameters.name: allocate_ipv6_port

parameters.help_en: The public IPv4 address that needs to provide IPv6 services. This is the IPv4 address of the IPv4-only server
parameters.help_zh: 需要提供IPv6服务的公网IPv4地址（IPv4-only的服务器的IPv4地址）。
parameters.name: backend_ipv4_addr

parameters.help_en: The port of the public IPv4 address that needs to provide IPv6 services
parameters.help_zh: 需要提供IPv6服务的公网IPv4地址的端口
parameters.name: backend_ipv4_port

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:

tcp: forwards TCP packets.  
udp: forwards UDP packets
parameters.help_zh:
协议类型。取值：

tcp：转发TCP协议的报文。  
udp：转发UDP协议的报文。
parameters.name: trans_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The maximum bandwidth of the IPv6 Translation Service mapping entry. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 

-1 (default): does not limit the maximum bandwidth of the mapping entry.  

1 to 200: the bandwidth value of the mapping entry.

The sum of the maximum bandwidth values of all IPv6 Translation Service mapping entries cannot exceed the maximum bandwidth of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6转换映射条目的带宽峰值。单位：Mbps。取值： 

-1（默认值）：不限制IPv6转换映射条目的带宽峰值。  

1~200：改映射条目的带宽值。

所有IPv6转换映射条目的带宽峰值之和不能超过实例的带宽峰值。
parameters.name: entry_bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable access control. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问控制。取值：
on：开启。
off：不开启
parameters.name: acl_status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the access control policy. Valid values:

white: allows the IPv6 addresses in the access control policy group to access backend services.

black: denies the IPv6 addresses in the access control policy group from accessing backend services
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略类型：

white：允许访问策略组中的IPv6地址访问后端服务。

black：禁止访问策略组中的IPv6地址访问后端服务
parameters.name: acl_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated access control policy group
parameters.help_zh: 关联的访问控制策略组ID
parameters.name: acl_id
